mostWorthwhile.text: Following inherited coat variation into cold-adapted populations was most worthwhile: it made natural selection clear without suggesting animals chose their traits.

leastWorthwhile.text: The river-migration sequence was less engaging because its results gave little detail about how the animals travelled.

surprise.text: The sheltered oasis clarified that migration requires both a usable route and a suitable destination, not just movement away from ice.

arbitrary.text: Using fire on surviving lineages to bring back warmth felt somewhat symbolic; its purpose was not clear from the pairing alone.

continue.text: I would probably continue: the contrast between migration, adaptation and loss made me curious about how the changed world develops, even if some intermediate results were sparse.
